name: Adamova Zorja
source:
A visual novel about a journey to the top of a mountain. Will the main characters be able to get to it - you will find out for yourself. 

[Translated from  [url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/adam-zorya]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部講述登山之旅的視覺小說。主角們能順利登頂嗎？親自去看看吧。

［譯自[url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/adam-zorya]itch.io[/url]］
